Save your C1 outfit with JBIB 41-0
Save your C2 outfit with JBIB 354-0
On C1: wear The Chica and wait for the yellow save icon
Go to Creator — activate Next DNS, Arcai NetCut, or your router to cut C1's connection
On C2: join an invite only session, equip the C2 outfit (JBIB 354-0), wait for the yellow save, then return to story mode
On C1: go into a new invite only lobby from Creator, change to the C1 outfit (JBIB 41-0), get a save, then return to story mode
Go back online — join an invite only session
You should spawn with JBIB 140-0. Walk to a wardrobe and save the outfit
